Heading: Built by people who've chased the paperwork
Intro: Tedwren started from a simple frustration: compliance falls apart the moment work leaves a gated site, and everyone ends up chasing cards and documents by email.

Sections.Heading: Why we're building it
Sections.Body: Retrofit and dispersed work is growing, and the tools assume a single site with a gate. We wanted compliance that holds up when there isn't one.

Sections.Heading: How we work
Sections.Body: We build closely with subcontractors, main contractors and workers, and we ship in small, testable steps rather than big-bang releases.

Sections.Heading: What we won't do
Sections.Body: We won't fake credibility with badges we haven't earned or reviews we don't have, and we won't position ourselves as something we're not.

MetaDescription: The story behind Tedwren: compliance that works beyond the site gate, built with subcontractors, main contractors and workers.
